response.justification: The candidate is an experienced full-stack/web engineer with strong TypeScript, Node.js, and DLang skills, but the role requires native-level Japanese, deep C/UNIX embedded development, Linux kernel source modification, and networking security expertise (MACsec, 802.1X, L2/L3 switching) — none of which are evidenced. His only C/C++ work was a brief 7-month stint in 2014–2015, and there is no Japanese language proficiency listed, which is a hard disqualifier for this position.
strengths: Long, diverse software career (15+ years) with strong engineering practices (TDD, CI/CD)
Some low-latency systems experience (async I/O, fibers) at Dunnhumby
Fluent English with proven technical communication and teaching skills
concerns: No Japanese language proficiency — a hard requirement (native level)
No embedded networking, LAN-switch, security protocol, or Linux kernel experience
Minimal C experience (single short role a decade ago); career centered on web/full-stack

key_factors.factor: Lack of embedded/networking security domain experience
